expected_doorway.title: Spirituality Without Escapism: Staying Human During Awakening Narratives
expected_doorway.rationale: This Archive essay examines spiritual growth alongside humility, discernment, responsibility, and ordinary human life. It offers a relevant next step for considering how humility keeps spiritual development grounded in lived conduct without treating spiritual claims as established fact.
